**Long press (more than 0.7 seconds)**: Open the APRS settings screen | | PTT | Switch the PTT arm status on the screen ON/OFF (an external switch for Port C is also required for actual transmission. See "Wiring for Port C" above) | | Back | Disconnect and return to the rig selection screen | | SPK | Turning the speaker (receiving audio) on/off | | DOWN / UP | You can increase or decrease the value of the selected item (Freq/Step/Mode/Wid/Pow/SQL) using the buttons | ### Rotary encoder (Port A / Unit Encoder) If you select an item with one of the Freq/Step/Mode/Wid/Pow/SQL buttons and turn it, you can increase or decrease the value of that item. --- ## 5. APRS settings (displayed by long pressing the APRS button) | Project | Content | |---|---| | APRS Enabled | ON/OFF of APRS function itself |
| Use GPS | ONの場合、Android(Tasker)から取得した位:
| Use GPS | When ON, automatically uses location information obtained from Android (Tasker) (manual input field is locked) |
| Latitude / Longitude | Use manual location information when GPS=OFF |
| APRS TXFreq | APRS beacon transmission frequency |
| Baudrate | 1200 / 9600 |
| TX Interval | Beacon transmission interval (30/60/120/180/300/600 seconds) |

**About GPS location information**: When Use GPS=ON, the Tasker HTTP server (see the port and path displayed at the bottom of the settings screen) must be started on the Android side.

---

## 6. Color theme

| Theme | Features |
|---|---|
| OCN (Ocean) | Standard color scheme (teal/blue) |
| AMB (Amber) | Vacuum tube/VFD style amber color. Calm color scheme for night operations |

Each theme has daytime mode (bright background, high contrast) and nighttime mode (dark background), which can be switched independently using the chip at the top right of the screen. Settings are saved on the device and persist after reboot.

# Wifi_RIG_CTRL for M5Stack CoreS3 SE  Ver 3.19

This firmware makes M5Stack CoreS3 SE a remote controller for radio equipment (rig).
Operate your rig via Raspberry Pi (Wifi_Rig_CTRL FastAPI backend) or ICOM WLAN Remote (CI-V over WiFi),
Supports APRS beacon transmission and PTT control via Wifi_Rig_PTT (relay board sold separately)/Hamlib.

by JI1ORE

---

## 1. Included files

| File | Contents |
|---|---|
| `src/` `include/` `platformio.ini` `merge_bin.py` | Source set (PlatformIO project) |
| `M5CoreHamCAT_CoreS3SE_v3.19.bin` | Pre-built firmware (merged, can be written to address 0x0) |

If you want to use the written `.bin` directly, write it to address 0x0 using esptool etc.

```bash
esptool.py --chip esp32s3 write_flash 0x0 M5CoreHamCAT_CoreS3SE_v3.19.bin
```

If you want to build it yourself, open this folder as a project in PlatformIO (VSCode extension or CLI) and
Run `Build` / `Upload`.

```bash
pio run # build
pio run -t upload # build + write
```

The files for M5Stack Core2 / M5Stack Core2 Tough are published in separate folders (`M5CoreHamCAT_Core2` / `M5CoreHamCAT_Core2Tough`).

---

## 2. Hardware connection (role of Port)

| Port | Pin | Application |
|---|---|---|
| **Port A** | SDA=G2 / SCL=G1 (+GND/5V):
| **Port A** | SDA=G2 / SCL=G1 (+GND/5V) | **Rotary encoder** (Connect M5 genuine I2C encoder unit Unit Encoder / SKU:U135) |
| **Port B** | G8 / G9 (+GND/5V) | **PTT key input (G8) + status LED (G9)**. Details below |

### Port B wiring (important)

- **G8 ⟷ GND**: Connect the PTT contact of an external toggle switch/foot switch/mechanical key (M5 genuine SK6812, etc.) here.
Since G8 has an internal pull-up (`INPUT_PULLUP`), you can simply connect the switch between G8 and Port B's GND (no additional components such as a pull-up resistor are required).
- **G9**: Data input for WS2812 compatible NeoPixel (1 light). Displays the transmission/reception status by LED color (described later).

> **Important specification**: The actual transmission (PTT ON) occurs only when **the "PTT" button on the screen is ON (`txEnabled`)** and **G8 of Port B is closed (LOW)**.
> Even if you tap only the "PTT" button on the screen, data will not be transmitted if nothing is connected to Port B.
> Assumed operation: This is a two-stage safety design in which transmission is permitted (armed) using the "PTT" button on the screen, and the actual transmission timing is controlled using an external switch (foot switch, etc.).

### Status LED (Port B, G9) color

| Color | Condition |
|---|---|
| Red | **Actually transmitting** (Hamlib / Wifi_Rig_PTT / CI-V any method) |
| Blue | Transmission standby (PTT button on screen = armed, PTT method = Wifi_Rig_PTT, no actual transmission) |
| Green | Transmission standby (PTT button on screen = armed, PTT method = Hamlib or CI-V) |
| Off | PTT button on screen OFF (transmission arm is released) |

### Screen orientation

CoreS3 SE does not rotate the screen (vertically flip it) and displays it in its normal orientation (screen flip is only available in the Core2 Tough version).

### Audio

In addition to the built-in microphone/speaker, CoreS3 SE allows you to select external Module Audio (ES8388, I2C separate from Port A/B: SDA=G12, SCL=G11).
On the setting screen (PTT Method screen), you can select the SPK output destination and Mic input destination independently from built-in/Module Audio (external).

### 3-1. Startup screen (splash)

When you turn on the power, the "Wifi_Rig_CTRL" logo will be displayed, followed by two buttons: **Normal** / **Skip**.

- **Normal**: Normal startup. Proceed in the following order: Wi-Fi selection → Raspberry Pi/CI-V connection → Rig selection → PTT method selection, checking the settings each time.
- **Skip**: Use the previously saved settings (Wi-Fi, Pi connection destination, rig, PTT method) to skip the confirmation screen and automatically connect to the main screen at once.

At the top left of the screen there is a small toggle labeled **Default:Normal/Default:Skip**. If you tap this and set it to "Default: Skip",
**If you do not tap anything for 8 seconds, the automatic transition destination will be Skip** (If you tap the Normal/Skip button on the spot, that will take priority).
If you want to start with Skip every time, you can set this default value to Skip once, and from then on it will automatically start with Skip without pressing a button.

### 3-2. Wi-Fi connection screen

Scans and displays a list of nearby Wi-Fi (Android tethering, etc.). Tap the SSID and enter the password to connect.

### 3-3. Raspberry Pi / CI-V connection screen

Switch the connection method using **"Pi Mode"/"CI-V"** at the top right of the screen.

- **Pi Mode** (via Raspberry Pi + rigctld/FastAPI backend)
- Hostname (or IP address. mDNS use/non-use can be switched)
  - API Port / Audio Port
- API Key (optional, only if authentication is required on the backend side)
- **CI-V**（ICOM WLAN Remote互換、無線機のWiFiに直:
- **CI-V** (ICOM WLAN Remote compatible, directly connected to radio's WiFi. No Pi required)
- Host (IP address of the radio)
- Ctrl Port / CIV Port / Addr(hex) (CI-V address)
- Username / Password (authentication information set on the radio device side)
- Timeout (time until the screen turns off when there is no operation)

After entering the information, tap "Connect".

### 3-4. Rig selection screen

Select the operation target from the rig list obtained from the connection destination (Pi/CI-V).

### 3-5. PTT mode selection screen

- **Wifi_PTT**: A method of sending PTT signals to the separately sold Wifi_Rig_PTT relay (Remotekeyer) via WiFi/UDP. This method was prepared to avoid the problem of not being able to modulate when using PTT via Hamlib on an ICOM machine.
- Set PTT Host (mDNS name or IP address) and PTT Port
- **Hamlib**: A method of performing normal CAT PTT control via rigctld.
- Set PTT Device (serial device) and PTT Type (RTS/DTR)

After setting, click "OK" to move to the main screen.

This is a CW keyer system using M5ATOM Lite.
It can be used in two ways.

① Wifi standalone mode
Using two M5ATOM Lite (client + server),
Relays ON/OFF of the telephone key in real time via WiFi.
You can remotely key wireless devices at distances that cannot be reached by wired devices (in a separate room or outdoors).

② USB relay mode (combined with Android app Wifi_RIG_CTRL v1.40)
Connect client M5ATOM to Android smartphone via USB,
The Android app relays the CW signal to the radio via the Raspberry Pi.
In CW mode, the key status is relayed as is, and in audio modes such as FM,
CW audio tones can be streamed and modulated.
CW operation over VPN is also possible from outside.

Overview
--------
Wifi_Rig_CW is a CW keyer system using M5ATOM Lite that supports two operation modes:

  Mode 1: WiFi Standalone
    Two M5ATOM Lite units (Client + Server) relay key ON/OFF over WiFi in real time.
    Enables remote CW keying of a radio in another room or location.

  Mode 2: USB Relay (with Android app "Wifi_RIG_CTRL" v1.40)
    Connect the Client M5ATOM to an Android smartphone via USB.
    The Android app relays key signals to a Raspberry Pi, which then controls the radio.
    - CW mode    : Key state is relayed as GPIO via Server M5ATOM → radio key terminal
    - FM/SSB etc : A 700 Hz CW audio tone is streamed to the radio's audio input
    Remote operation over WireGuard VPN (from outside your home network) is also supported.


Firmware Files
--------------
  Clie_M5AtomLitev1.40.bin   Client firmware (connect your key to this unit)
  Serv_M5AtomLitev1.40.bin   Server firmware (connect to radio key terminal via optocoupler)


Switching Between USB and WiFi Modes
-------------------------------------
Within the first 10 seconds after power-on:
  Short press   Switch WiFi profile (LED color changes per profile)
  Long press (1 sec)   Toggle between USB mode (LED = RED) and WiFi mode (LED = profile color)

The selected mode is saved to EEPROM and remembered after power cycling.


Setup — WiFi Standalone Mode
-----------------------------
1. Flash Client firmware to one M5ATOM Lite, Server firmware to the other.
2. Edit the WiFi profile template (wifi_client_profile.txt / wifi_server_profile.txt)
   with your SSID, password, and hostnames.
3. Copy the profile file to the root of a MicroSD card.
4. Insert the MicroSD into the M5ATOM's TF-CARD slot and power on.
5. The M5ATOM reads the profile and connects to WiFi automatically.

LED status (WiFi mode):
  Profile color   Connecting / searching for server
  Green           Connected to server, key OFF
  Key pressed     Green (bright)


Setup — USB Relay Mode
-----------------------
Requirements:
  Android smartphone with Wifi_RIG_CTRL v1.40 installed
  Raspberry Pi Zero 2W (set up with create_api.sh from RaspberryPiSetup folder)

Steps:
  1. Connect the key to the Client M5ATOM (GROVE terminal)
  2. Connect M5ATOM to Android via OTG USB cable
  3. Long press the M5ATOM button for 1 second until LED turns RED (USB mode)
  4. Tap "OK" when Android asks for USB device permission
5. The Wifi_RIG_CTRL app shows "CW relay" or "Audio relay" on the main screen

LED status (USB mode):
  Dim blue   USB mode, waiting / key OFF
  Bright blue   Key ON

For CW mode (GPIO relay), the Server M5ATOM is also required.
It must be connected to the radio's key terminal via optocoupler circuit.
For FM-CW / audio streaming mode, only the Client M5ATOM is needed.

---------------

  [Key] → [M5ATOM Client] ─── WiFi ───> [M5ATOM Server] → [Radio key terminal]

USB Relay (CW mode):
  [Key] → [M5ATOM] ─USB─> [Android] ─── WiFi/VPN ───> [Raspberry Pi] ─── WiFi ───> [M5ATOM Server] → [Radio key terminal]

USB Relay (FM-CW / audio mode):
  [Key] → [M5ATOM] ─USB─> [Android] ─── WiFi/VPN ───> [Raspberry Pi] ─── USB audio ──> [Radio mic input]

## 2. How to use

1. Restart after programming (dial OFF→ON).

### Key operation

> Firmware is now **Composite USB HID Device: Keyboard + Mouse**. Default typing = keyboard input; hold down `Fn` to enter mouse shortcut mode.

| **Shake/Tap** | Click (default left button) |
| **BtnA (G0 key, side of the fuselage)** | Press and hold = left button drag |

**Mouse shortcuts (requires holding down Fn):**

| Operation | Effect |
| --------------------------- | -------------------------------- |
| **`Fn` + `-` / `Fn` + `=`** | Decrease/increase cursor speed (1 ~ 10 levels, screen SPD status bar) |
| **`Fn` + `0`** | Recalibrate the "horizontal attitude" (put the fuselage at the center angle you want) |

- **ESP32-S3 native USB** directly connects to the **HID Mouse** device (no driver required, Win10/11/macOS/Linux automatically recognizes it).
- The `M5Cardputer` library reads the TCA8418 keyboard controller (I²C 0x34).
- `IMU_Class` of `M5.Unified` drives the BMI270 (0x68) via the internal I²C bus, providing acceleration + gyroscope.

- Tilt posture: Use the rotation angle `atan2(sin, cos)` between the acceleration vector and the "neutral reference" to shape the response curve of the dead zone and sensitivity (`RESPONSE_EXP`).
- "Shake" = It detects that the acceleration amplitude instantly deviates from 1g and exceeds the threshold of 0.55g, triggering a left mouse button pulse.
- Send mouse displacement packets in 8ms period (≈125 Hz), and the speed gear (1~10) scales the pixels proportionally.

```bash
    --output-dir build sketch
```

## 5. Parameter tuning

Open `sketch/sketch.ino`, with the complete set of tunable parameters at the top:

```cpp
static constexpr float TILT_FULL_DEG = 35.0f; // How many degrees of tilt = full speed

static constexpr int SPEED_DEFAULT = 4; //Default speed gear
static constexpr float DEADZONE_DEG = 1.2f; // dead zone
static constexpr float RESPONSE_EXP = 1.7f; // Response curve (>1, the closer to the center, the thinner)
static constexpr float SHAKE_TRIG_G = 0.55f; //Shake trigger threshold (g deviation)
static constexpr uint32_t SHAKE_DEBOUNCE = 380; // Shake interval
```

## 6. Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: There is no response when plugged into the computer after burning? **
A: 确认 USB 数据线支持数据传输（纯充电线不行）；检查 Device Ma:
A: Confirm that the USB data cable supports data transmission (a pure charging cable will not work); check whether Device Manager sees "HID-compliant Mouse".

**Q: Is the tilt direction reversed? **
A: Swap the symbols of `tiltComponent(0)` or `tiltComponent(1)` in the source code; or exchange `nx`/`ny`.

**Q: Is it too sensitive/insensitive to shake it? **
A: Change `SHAKE_TRIG_G` (default 0.55g, the larger the value, the less sensitive) and `SHAKE_DEBOUNCE` (default 380 ms).

**Q: Do batteries need to be used? **
A: No need. USB-C power supply is enough, and the IMU + USB HID is fully online.

Offline TXT e-book reader on M5Stack Cardputer ADV (ESP32-S3).

## Core functions

- Offline reading of TXT, automatic paging, chapter recognition (built-in rules + custom regular rules)
- Bookshelf management: recently read sorting, renaming, deletion, password-protected hidden bookshelf
- Reading assistance: directory jump, bookmarks, percentage progress, 5 themes, brightness adjustment, automatic sleep

- WiFi book transfer: browser uploads TXT, supports large files in chunks; import and export bookmarks
- Chinese and English bilingual interface

## Hardware and installation

- Adapted to M5Stack Cardputer ADV (ESP32-S3, no PSRAM)
- SD card SPI: SCK 40 / MISO 39 / MOSI 14 / CS 12, 25MHz
- The partition plan needs to be **Huge APP (3MB)**
- The firmware size is about 1.5MB and can be burned directly through M5Burner or esptool

## Known limitations

- Use the first pronunciation of polyphonic words in a phrase. Some phrases (such as "Chongqing") need to be separated into single characters for input.
- Use `--` for dashes instead of standard U+2014
- Rename rejects file names starting with `.`

# StickS3 DeepSeek 余额 / 用量显示器\n\n**固件名称*:
# StickS3 DeepSeek Balance/Usage Monitor

**Firmware name**: StickS3 DeepSeek Info
**Current version**: v1.0.0
**Applicable devices**: M5Stack StickS3 (ESP32-S3 / 8MB Flash / 8MB PSRAM / 135×240 screen / BMI270)
**Interface language**: Simplified Chinese
**Networking method**: 2.4GHz Wi-Fi
**Data service**: DeepSeek official API + DeepSeek open platform account data

> **Introduction in one sentence**: Display DeepSeek balance, today's consumption, number of requests and Tokens in real time on M5Stack StickS3, support web configuration, key security management and four-way automatic rotation.

---

## 1. Firmware introduction

This is a desktop information screen firmware built for M5Stack StickS3, used to check the balance and daily usage of the DeepSeek account at any time.

The device connects to the network via Wi-Fi, automatically obtains and scrolls refreshes the following data, and displays it on the 1.14-inch screen:

- **Account Balance**
- **Today’s consumption amount**
- **Number of API requests today**
- **Tokens consumed today**

The firmware supports web configuration, automatic horizontal and vertical screen rotation, key operation, disconnection reconnection and abnormal prompts. The configuration is saved locally on the device and will not be lost when the power is off.

> Note: DeepSeek's official API Key can only query the balance; today's consumption, number of requests, and Tokens come from the account data interface used on the open platform web page, so this firmware adopts a dual-channel design of "Official API Key + Platform Login Token".

---

## 2. Main functions

### 1. Dual channel data

| Data items | Data sources | Configuration items |
|---|---|---|
| Balance | DeepSeek official balance interface | API Key |
| Today’s Consumption | Open Platform Usage Interface | Platform Token |
| Number of requests today | Open platform usage interface | Platform Token |
| Today's Tokens | Open Platform Usage Interface | Platform Tokens |

- Both are configured: the balance goes through the official interface, and the usage goes through the platform interface, without affecting each other;
- Only configure the platform Token: the balance displays the platform wallet summary;
- Only configure the API Key: only the balance is displayed, and the usage item displays `--`.

### 2. Screen display
竖屏与横屏均提供两页界面：\n\n**页面 1：余额与今日用量**\n\n- 账:
Both vertical and horizontal screens provide a two-page interface:

**Page 1: Balance and today’s usage**

- Account balance (RMB is displayed as `123.45 yuan`)
- Today’s consumption amount
- Number of requests today
- Today's Tokens
- Gift balance/recharge balance (if using platform Token)
- Data update time, countdown to next refresh, and current status prompts

**Page 2: Accounts and Network**

- Gift balance, recharge balance, platform balance
- API Key/Platform Token status
- Wi-Fi signal strength, device IP
- Refresh interval, running time
- Current management PIN, firmware version

**Network configuration interface**

- Distribution network hotspot name and hotspot password
- Configure URL `192.168.4.1`
- 6-digit management PIN
- Configuration step tips

**Exception prompt**

- Token invalidation, API Key invalidation, platform current limiting, network disconnection, waiting for time adjustment, etc. will be clearly displayed.
- When the acquisition fails, the last successful data is retained and marked as "old data", and the reason for the failure is displayed.
- The "update" time is always the latest successful time and will not be disguised as the current time.

### 3. Web configuration network

- Automatically enter the network distribution mode (SoftAP + Captive Portal) when booting for the first time
- After connecting the mobile phone or computer to the hotspot, open `192.168.4.1` in the browser to configure
- Configuring the web page requires entering the **6-digit management PIN** found on the device screen
- Support Wi-Fi scanning and drop-down selection
- Support filling in API Key, platform Token, time zone, refresh interval, screen brightness
- Supports "Test Connection", "Refresh Now" and "Factory Reset"
- After the device is connected to the Internet, the configuration page can be opened through the device IP on the same LAN
- Support mDNS: `http://sticks3-xxxx.local`

### 4. Automatic rotation

- Built-in BMI270 six-axis sensor, automatically identifies the device direction
- Supports four directions: portrait screen, vertical screen inverted, horizontal screen, and horizontal screen reversed
- Maintain the current orientation when the screen is laid flat to avoid flipping back and forth when placed on the desktop
- The direction is stable for about 350ms before switching to reduce jitter.
- You can turn off automatic rotation on the configuration page, or enable "reverse landscape orientation" correction

### 5. Key operation

| Keys | Operations | Functions |
|---|---|---|
| BtnA | Short press | Refresh data immediately |
| BtnA | Press and hold for about 1.8 seconds | Enter distribution mode (restart as hotspot) |
| BtnB | Short press | Page 1 / Page 2 switch |
| Wi-Fi SSID / 密码 | 仅支持 2.4GHz；更换 SSID 后:
| Wi-Fi SSID / Password | Only supports 2.4GHz; you need to refill the password after changing the SSID | — |
| API Key | Used for official balance interface | Empty |
| Platform Token | Used for today’s consumption, number of requests, Tokens | Empty |
| Time zone | "Today" is reset at 0 o'clock in the time zone | GMT+8 |
| Refresh interval | 30–3600 seconds; too small may trigger platform current limiting | 60 seconds |
| Screen brightness | 10–255 | 200 |
| Automatic rotation | Switch between horizontal and vertical screens according to device orientation | Enable |
| Reverse landscape orientation | Check if landscape screen is upside down | Close |

The configuration is saved in the local NVS of the device and will not be lost when the power is off. Leaving the key input box blank on the web page means keeping the original value; factory reset will also clear the Wi-Fi credentials saved on the device.

---

## 5. Security and Privacy

- The distribution network hotspot uses a WPA2 random password, which is updated every time it is started and displayed on the device screen;
- The configuration web page requires a randomly generated 6-digit management PIN each time it is launched;
- Use HttpOnly + SameSite session cookies after logging in, and verify the request source for write operations;
- Only the key mask is displayed on the web page, and the complete API Key or Token is not returned;
- All configurations are only saved locally on the device and are not uploaded to any third-party server;
- The device web page is LAN HTTP, please only use it in a trusted network environment;
- When the device is lost, please go to the platform to "Exit all sessions" and delete the corresponding API Key.

---

## 6. Operating conditions

- Hardware: M5Stack StickS3;
- Network: 2.4GHz Wi-Fi accessible to `api.deepseek.com` and `platform.deepseek.com`;
- Account: DeepSeek account (API Key and platform login Token);
- Time: The device needs to be connected to the Internet to complete NTP time synchronization (HTTPS certificate verification depends on the system time).

---

## 7. Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: The screen displays `--` / "Platform Token needs to be configured"? **
Only the API Key is configured. Today's consumption, number of requests, and tokens require platform token.

**Q: Prompt "Token is invalid, please update"? **
The platform token has expired or been logged out. Follow the above method to obtain and save it again.

**Q: It prompts "Usage not updated"/Usage is always `--`? **
说明余额通道正常，但平台用量接口请求失败。可查看设备串口日志或访问设备状态 JS:
It means that the balance channel is normal, but the platform usage interface request failed. You can view the device serial port log or access the `amount_err` / `cost_err` fields in the device status JSON to locate the cause; common ones are Token invalidation, platform current limiting or network timeout.

**Q: The page does not respond after entering the management PIN? **
Make sure you enter the PIN currently on the device's screen (it will change after restarting); you can also directly access `http://192.168.4.1/?pin=PIN on the screen`. If you use the mobile Captive Portal small window, it is recommended to use a normal browser instead.

**Q: Can’t scan Wi-Fi? **
StickS3 only supports 2.4GHz. After the scan is completed, select from the "Scan Result" drop-down box below the Wi-Fi name input box; you can also enter the SSID manually.

**Q: The automatic rotation direction is wrong? **
The firmware has been calibrated to the StickS3 actual IMU axis. If only the horizontal screen is turned upside down, check "Reverse horizontal screen direction" on the configuration page; you can turn it off directly if automatic rotation is not needed.

**Q: What should I do if the refresh fails? **
The device will retain the last successful data and display the reason for failure. For network problems, check Wi-Fi and time synchronization; for authentication problems, re-configure the key; the platform current limit can be adjusted to a large refresh interval.

**Q: Battery life? **
When the Wi-Fi is always connected and the screen is always on, the power consumption is high. It is recommended to use USB power supply. You can also turn off the backlight by long pressing BtnB to save power.

---

## 8. Version record

### v1.0.0

- first release
- Supports DeepSeek balance, today's consumption, number of requests, and Tokens display
- Supports web configuration, Wi-Fi scanning, and key testing
- Support dual-channel data and failure prompts
- Supports automatic rotation in four directions
-Supports key refresh, page turning, and backlight control
- Supports disconnection reconnection, NTP timing, error backoff and old data marking
-Supports web page management PIN, WPA2 network distribution hotspot, key mask display

---

## 9. Disclaimer

- This firmware is an unofficial third-party application and has no official affiliation with DeepSeek;
- Platform usage data comes from the account interface used on its web page, and is not an official public API. It may need to be adapted after the platform is updated;
- Please abide by the DeepSeek Terms of Service, only query your account data, and avoid high-frequency requests;
- The account, key and device security risks arising from the use of this firmware are borne by the user.

- Wi-Fi name and password (2.4GHz only);
- DeepSeek API Key (for balance);
- Platform Token (for today’s usage);
- Time zone (default GMT+8);

```js
copy(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('userToken')).value)
```

4. Paste the clipboard content into the "Platform Token" input box on the web page.

Platform Token is equivalent to web page login credentials, please do not share them; you need to obtain it again after logging out of the platform, changing your password, or after Token expires, and the device will prompt "Token expired, please update."

---

## 4. Configuration item description

| Configuration items | Description | Default value |
|---|---|---|
| Wi-Fi SSID / Password | Only supports 2.4GHz; you need to refill the password after changing the SSID | — |
| API Key | Used for official balance interface | Empty |
| Platform Token | Used for today’s consumption, number of requests, Tokens | Empty |
| Time zone | "Today" is reset at 0 o'clock in the time zone | GMT+8 |
| Refresh interval | 30–3600 seconds; too small may trigger platform current limiting | 60 seconds |
| Screen brightness | 10–255 | 200 |
| Automatic rotation | Switch between horizontal and vertical screens according to device orientation | Enable |
| Reverse landscape orientation | Check if landscape screen is upside down | Close |

The configuration is saved in the local NVS of the device and will not be lost when the power is off. Leaving the key input box blank on the web page means keeping the original value; factory reset will also clear the Wi-Fi credentials saved on the device.

---

## 5. Security and Privacy

- The distribution network hotspot uses a WPA2 random password, which is updated every time it is started and displayed on the device screen;
- The configuration web page requires a randomly generated 6-digit management PIN each time it is launched;
- Use HttpOnly + SameSite session cookies after logging in, and verify the request source for write operations;
- Only the key mask is displayed on the web page, and the complete API Key or Token is not returned;
- All configurations are only saved locally on the device and are not uploaded to any third-party server;
- The device web page is LAN HTTP, please only use it in a trusted network environment;
- When the device is lost, please go to the platform to "Exit all sessions" and delete the corresponding API Key.

---

## 6. Operating conditions

- Hardware: M5Stack StickS3;
- Network: 2.4GHz Wi-Fi accessible to `api.deepseek.com` and `platform.deepseek.com`;
- Account: DeepSeek account (API Key and platform login Token);
- Time: The device needs to be connected to the Internet to complete NTP time synchronization (HTTPS certificate verification depends on the system time).

---

## 7. Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: The screen displays `--` / "Platform Token needs to be configured"? **
Only the API Key is configured. Today's consumption, number of requests, and tokens require platform token.

**Q: Prompt "Token is invalid, please update"? **
The platform token has expired or been logged out. Follow the above method to obtain and save it again.

**Q: It prompts "Usage not updated"/Usage is always `--`? **
It means that the balance channel is normal, but the platform usage interface request failed. You can view the device serial port log or access the `amount_err` / `cost_err` fields in the device status JSON to locate the cause; common ones are Token invalidation, platform current limiting or network timeout.

**Q: The page does not respond after entering the management PIN? **
Make sure you enter the PIN currently on the device's screen (it will change after restarting); you can also directly access `http://192.168.4.1/?pin=PIN on the screen`. If you use the mobile Captive Portal small window, it is recommended to use a normal browser instead.

**Q: Can’t scan Wi-Fi? **
StickS3 only supports 2.4GHz. After the scan is completed, select from the "Scan Result" drop-down box below the Wi-Fi name input box; you can also enter the SSID manually.

**Q: The automatic rotation direction is wrong? **
The firmware has been calibrated to the StickS3 actual IMU axis. If only the horizontal screen is turned upside down, check "Reverse horizontal screen direction" on the configuration page; you can turn it off directly if automatic rotation is not needed.

**Q: What should I do if the refresh fails? **
The device will retain the last successful data and display the reason for failure. For network problems, check Wi-Fi and time synchronization; for authentication problems, re-configure the key; the platform current limit can be adjusted to a large refresh interval.

**Q: Battery life? **
When the Wi-Fi is always connected and the screen is always on, the power consumption is high. It is recommended to use USB power supply. You can also turn off the backlight by long pressing BtnB to save power.

## use

Automatically enter the configuration network when starting unsaved Wi-Fi for the first time; you can also click the **A button** to enter the configuration network at any time. Click the **B key** to exit and return to the clock.

3. Scan and select your home Wi-Fi, or manually fill in the hidden network name, enter the password and save it.

## Power supply and status

- The Wi-Fi icon indicates that the latest calibration was successful, but does not mean that the wireless network has always been connected; an X is displayed when it fails or is not calibrated.

- If the power supply is plugged in during battery mode hibernation, the power supply change will be recognized after waking up in the next minute.
- A placeholder is displayed when there is no valid time; when the network is not configured, press B to return to the clock, and it will not be forced to enter the network configuration when it wakes up in the next minute.

# Pocket Studio

A pocket music workstation developed for **M5Stack Cardputer ADV**, integrating real-time performance, multi-track arrangement, sampling and tone production, and music playback.

## Multi-track arrangement

- Three melody tracks, each track supports four-note polyphony, and seventh chords can be played manually.
- Independent drum track providing eight drum sounds.
- Supports real-time performance, loop recording and STEP step input.
- Supports 1, 2, and 4-bar loops, as well as global BPM, master volume, and track mute.

## Chords and Arpeggios

- Supports project transposition and major and natural minor keys.
- Automatically tune internal triads: Press a root note to generate the corresponding chord.
- Arpeggiator supports uplink, downlink and round trip modes.
- Adjust tempo, voicing ratio, octave range and keep playing with HOLD.

## Drum Machine

- Eight drum sounds: kick, snare, clap, closed hi-hat, open hi-hat, bass tom, treble tom and percussion.
- Supports real-time performance of drum pads and line-by-line step editing.
- Adjustable drum volume, pitch, mute, solo and swing.

## Sampling and sound production

- Supports microphone recording, recording countdown and WAV import.
- Provides waveform display, selection audition, fine cropping and cropping saving.
-Supports single playback, key gate control and continuous looping.
- Independent loop areas and seam crossfade can be set.
- After the sound is saved to the SD card, it can be played on the melody track.

## Sound Design

- Provides sine wave, triangle wave, square wave, sawtooth wave and white noise.
- Dual oscillators support waveform mixing and pitch adjustment.
- ADSR volume envelope, pitch envelope and filter envelope.
- LFO can modulate pitch, filter cutoff frequency or volume.
- Provides low-pass filtering, resonance, soft distortion and bit depth degradation.

## Music player

- Support browsing SD card directory.
- Supports 16bit PCM WAV and common MP3 files.
- Provides play, pause, song change, progress jump and independent volume adjustment.

## Storage and usage conditions

- Arrangement projects can be saved to internal storage or SD card.
- Sample material, sound settings and recordings are saved on the SD card.
- The basic arrangement can be used without an SD card; the sampler, sampled sounds and player require an SD card.

TouchFish News is a desktop news board for M5Stack PaperDIY. It combines news, minimalist pet interaction,
The lunar calendar and holiday information are displayed on 4.7-inch electronic paper, suitable for placement on desks, entrances or offices.
As a low-power information screen.


## hardware

- M5Stack PaperDIY Complete Kit
- ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8
- 16 MB Flash，8 MB Octal PSRAM
- 4.7 inches 960×540 grayscale e-paper
- Wi-Fi 2.4 GHz
- Body power button
- KEY1：GPIO4
- KEY2：GPIO3

## Function

- News topics: finance, general, technology, AI, sports, aerospace, international and entertainment
- News source:
- Wall Street Insights
- Sina Finance
- Oriental Fortune
- IT Home
- Sina Entertainment
  - Wall Street Journal
  - Hacker News
  - ESPN
  - arXiv AI
  - NASA
- News sources are selected in separate pages
- The source will be actually crawled online before switching, and will not switch when the network fails.
- News is updated every 10 minutes by default, and can be synchronized manually in real time
- Pet expressions change with date, holiday, night and key interaction
- Gregorian calendar, lunar calendar, holiday names and countdown
- Reminder to clock in and out on workdays, specific time can be set
- Mobile phone scanning code web page configuration
- Supports 4 screen orientations, each rotates 90° counterclockwise
- Independent layout for horizontal and vertical screens
- Partial refresh of e-paper to reduce flickering and image retention on the entire screen
- Fixed use of UTC+8

## Booting up and daily use

After the device is turned on, the startup log will be displayed first, then the Wi-Fi, synchronization time and network data will be checked in sequence, and then enter
Pet News Board.

Kanban button:

- KEY1 short press: interact with pets
- Long press on KEY1: synchronize news and holidays immediately
- KEY2 short press: open settings

Set button:

- Short press KEY1: the cursor moves up
- KEY2 short press: cursor moves down
- KEY1 long press: Confirm the current option
- KEY2 long press: return to the previous level

Time selection and news source selection also use the same logic: short press to select, long press to confirm, long press KEY2 to return.

## First time network configuration

1. Short press KEY2 on the dashboard to open the settings.
2. Move to "Wi-Fi Network" and long press KEY1 to confirm.
3. 手机扫描屏幕二维码，加入 `InkPet-Paper-XXXX` 临时热点:
3. Scan the QR code on the screen with your mobile phone to join the `InkPet-Paper-XXXX` temporary hotspot.
4. Select your home Wi-Fi in the web page that opens and enter the password.
5. After the device is connected to the Internet, it automatically saves the configuration, synchronizes the time and returns to the dashboard.

If the phone does not automatically open the network configuration page, access it after connecting to the hotspot:

```text
http://192.168.4.1
```

## News source switch

1. Open settings and enter "News Sources".
2. Use KEY1 / KEY2 up and down to select the source.
3. Press and hold KEY1 to start network detection.
4. Switch immediately after the capture is successful; if failed, the original source will be retained and a network error will be displayed.

The current source will be displayed at the bottom of the main interface.

## Check-in reminder

Turn on "Punch-in Reminder" in settings, and then enter "Working Time" and "Off-Working Time" respectively:

- Short press KEY1 / KEY2 to adjust in 30 minute increments
- Long press KEY1 to save
- Long press KEY2 to cancel and return

Reminders are only triggered on weekdays.

## Notes

- The news interface is a public or unofficial interface, and the format or access policy may be adjusted in the future.
- When the interface is temporarily unavailable during holidays, it will fall back to built-in data.
- Wall Street Journal, Hacker News, ESPN, arXiv, and NASA content in English.
- News source switching and scheduled refresh will consume network traffic and a certain amount of battery.

  - Hacker News
  - ESPN
  - arXiv AI
  - NASA
- News sources are selected in separate pages
- The source will be actually crawled online before switching, and will not switch when the network fails.
- News is updated every 10 minutes by default, and can be synchronized manually in real time
- Pet expressions change with date, holiday, night and key interaction
- Gregorian calendar, lunar calendar, holiday names and countdown
- Reminder to clock in and out on workdays, specific time can be set
- Mobile phone scanning code web page configuration
- Supports 4 screen orientations, each rotates 90° counterclockwise
- Independent layout for horizontal and vertical screens
- Partial refresh of e-paper to reduce flickering and image retention on the entire screen
- Fixed use of UTC+8

## Booting up and daily use

After the device is turned on, the startup log will be displayed first, then the Wi-Fi, synchronization time and network data will be checked in sequence, and then enter
Pet News Board.

Kanban button:

- KEY1 short press: interact with pets
- Long press on KEY1: synchronize news and holidays immediately
- KEY2 short press: open settings

Set button:

- Short press KEY1: the cursor moves up
- KEY2 short press: cursor moves down
- KEY1 long press: Confirm the current option
- KEY2 long press: return to the previous level

Time selection and news source selection also use the same logic: short press to select, long press to confirm, long press KEY2 to return.

## First time network configuration

1. Short press KEY2 on the dashboard to open the settings.
2. Move to "Wi-Fi Network" and long press KEY1 to confirm.
3. Scan the QR code on the screen with your mobile phone to join the `InkPet-Paper-XXXX` temporary hotspot.
4. Select your home Wi-Fi in the web page that opens and enter the password.
5. After the device is connected to the Internet, it automatically saves the configuration, synchronizes the time and returns to the dashboard.

If the phone does not automatically open the network configuration page, access it after connecting to the hotspot:

```text
http://192.168.4.1
```

## News source switch

1. Open settings and enter "News Sources".
2. Use KEY1 / KEY2 up and down to select the source.
3. Press and hold KEY1 to start network detection.
4. Switch immediately after the capture is successful; if failed, the original source will be retained and a network error will be displayed.

The current source will be displayed at the bottom of the main interface.

## Check-in reminder

Turn on "Punch-in Reminder" in settings, and then enter "Working Time" and "Off-Working Time" respectively:

- Short press KEY1 / KEY2 to adjust in 30 minute increments
- Long press KEY1 to save
- Long press KEY2 to cancel and return

Reminders are only triggered on weekdays.

## Notes

- The news interface is a public or unofficial interface, and the format or access policy may be adjusted in the future.
- When the interface is temporarily unavailable during holidays, it will fall back to built-in data.
- Wall Street Journal, Hacker News, ESPN, arXiv, and NASA content in English.
- News source switching and scheduled refresh will consume network traffic and a certain amount of battery.

This is a pixel style aquarium cultivation game. You can raise fish, hatch eggs, and breed fish in a fish tank, or you can drive a submarine to explore the deep sea. It also comes with 4 mini-games.

This is a pixel-art aquarium simulation game. You can raise fish, hatch eggs, and breed them in your tank, or pilot a submarine to explore the deep sea—plus, it includes four built-in mini-games.

- **Main interface (fish tank)**: F/Enter to feed, G to switch food, N to select fish, T for snacks, C for cleaning, L for lighting, P for laser to poke golden bubbles, R for teasing crabs, and K for illustrations, V for genetic laboratory, M for mini-games, E for adventure, B for shops, Q for tasks, A for relics, W for weather, S for settings, and H for help.
- **Deep Sea Adventure (Submarine)**: WASD swimming, Space sonar, F harpoon, G electromagnetic pulse, Enter interaction/docking/rescue, M map, N mini map, Esc pause, Q emergency resurfacing, with a reminder about oxygen and bounty.
- **Mini Games**: Pearl Hunting, Reef Dash, Crab Battle (3×3 keys), Coral Echo respective operations.
- **Menu/Shop/Illustrated Book**: `;` `.` to select, `,` `/` to switch tabs, Enter to confirm or purchase (click twice to sell), B/Esc to return.
